visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Capital Letters Are Removed with the Punctuation
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The Panama sentence is a palindrome and should print true, but the program prints false.

solution.explanation: The pattern [^a-z0-9] means "anything that is not a lower-case letter or digit", so capital letters are deleted along with the punctuation unless the text is lower-cased first.
